---
title: "Data"
---

All data lives under one root folder, `data/`, with three parts:

| Folder | Contents | In git |
|---|---|---|
| `data/raw/` | Files exactly as downloaded | No |
| `data/processed/` | Files derived from raw data by scripts | No |
| `data/snapshots/` | Frozen copies used by a published result, each with a SHA-256 hash | No (published as release assets) |

Study-specific inputs live in `studies/<name>/data/` and are documented in each
study's README. Nothing in these folders is committed; each file is either
fetched by a script from its source or generated from other files.

| Dataset | Source | Licence | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Earthquake catalogue (M5+) | [USGS ComCat](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/) | Public domain (US Government) | Earthquake study |
| Gold price (XAU/USD, COMEX GC=F fallback) | Yahoo Finance via `yfinance` | Yahoo terms of use; not redistributed | Gold market study |
| Athlete names and birth dates | [stat408 athletes dataset](https://github.com/stat408/Data) | See the source repository | Numerology study |
| Planetary positions | Swiss Ephemeris (`pyswisseph`) | AGPL / Swiss Ephemeris licence | All studies |

`make check-data` prints the SHA-256 hash and row count of every required input
file, so a result can be tied to the exact data it used. The list of sources,
licences and hashes is kept in
[data/README.md](https://github.com/astro-fusion/astro_research-white-paper/blob/main/data/README.md).

## Mundane datasets

The mundane study keeps two small tracked files in `studies/mundane/data/` and
fetches larger catalogues on demand into the gitignored `data/snapshots/`, each
with a manifest holding its SHA-256.

| Dataset | Source | Licence | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Founding dates and capitals (113 countries) | AstroFusion mundane dataset, export 2026-11-08; founding times are unknown and recorded as null | CC BY 4.0 (dates, coordinates, titles) | Mundane study |
| National events (825; titles, dates, types, Wikipedia and Wikidata links, no descriptions) | AstroFusion mundane dataset, built from Wikipedia lists and Wikidata; types unreviewed | CC BY 4.0; event descriptions omitted (Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA) | Mundane study |
| Earthquake catalogue (M6+, 1900-2026) | [USGS FDSN event service](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/) | Public domain (US Government) | Mundane study |
| Global flood archive | Dartmouth Flood Observatory | See the DFO site; fetched on demand with a local file or URL | Mundane study |
| EM-DAT disaster database | CRED, UCLouvain | Registration required; not redistributable; fetch-on-demand only | Mundane study (optional) |

## Market datasets

The gold and silver studies fetch their price series on each run, in the
order given by their `hypothesis.yaml`, and write the download to the
gitignored `data/snapshots/` with a manifest. The SHA-256, row count and date
range of the series a published result used are recorded in that study's
`artifacts/results.json` and `artifacts/manifest.json`.

| Dataset | Source | Licence | Rows, range (run of 2026-11-08) | SHA-256 | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gold, COMEX front-month continuous futures (`GC=F`), not spot | Yahoo Finance via `yfinance` | Yahoo terms of use; not redistributed | 6,150 trading days, 2000-09-05 to 2026-10-30 | `3085b0d501ec...` | [Gold market](../studies/gold_market/paper/manuscript.qmd) |
| Silver, COMEX front-month continuous futures (`SI=F`), not spot | Yahoo Finance via `yfinance` | Yahoo terms of use; not redistributed | 5,824 trading days, 2000-08-30 to 2026-10-30 | `bb3e274e4079...` | [Silver market](../studies/silver_market/paper/manuscript.qmd) |
| LBMA gold PM fix (`GOLDPMGBD228NLBM`), LBMA silver (`SLVPRUSD`) | FRED | ICE Benchmark Administration | Pre-registered first choice; withdrawn from FRED in 2022 (HTTP 404) | - | Not used |
| Market fixtures, 2015-2020 | Yahoo `GC=F`, `SI=F`; FRED `DEXUSUK` sample | As above | 1,480 / 1,377 / 16 rows | in `tests/fixtures/markets/` | Tests and the offline (provisional) fallback |

Zero-volume rows are stale quotes and are dropped. Futures rolls are not
back-adjusted. Each study also writes `artifacts/overlay_frame.csv`: one row
per trading day with the close, daily and forward log returns, and every
indicator as 0/1, the file the site's explorer will load. It is regenerated
by the pipeline and not committed, because it contains the price series.
